mapper.sql: WITH source AS ( SELECT p.*,c.clnt_nm AS customer_name,cp.part_id,b.part_nm AS part_name, CASE WHEN p.proj_stat_cd='LOSE' THEN 'LOSE' WHEN p.ctrt_end_dt < #{today} THEN 'END' ELSE p.proj_stat_cd END AS effective_status, ct.code_nm AS type_name,st.code_nm AS status_name, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id)::integer FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.proj_id=p.proj_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.input_end_dt >= #{today}) AS person_count FROM tb_pj_proj p LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=p.cust_clnt_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.part_id FROM tb_pj_proj_part r WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id ORDER BY (r.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month}) DESC, CASE WHEN r.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} THEN r.aply_bgn_ym END DESC,r.aply_bgn_ym ASC LIMIT 1) cp ON true LEFT JOIN tb_bs_part b ON b.part_id=cp.part_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code ct ON ct.code_grp_id='CTRT_TYPE' AND ct.code=p.ctrt_type_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code st ON st.code_grp_id='PROJ_STAT' AND st.code=CASE WHEN p.proj_stat_cd='LOSE' THEN 'LOSE' WHEN p.ctrt_end_dt < #{today} THEN 'END' ELSE p.proj_stat_cd END )

choose.when: AND p.ctrt_type_cd<>'IN' AND p.part_id IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT p.proj_id AS id,p.proj_nm AS name,p.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",p.ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate", CASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd='IN' THEN NULL ELSE trim_scale(p.ctrt_amt)::text END AS "contractAmount",p.effective_status AS status, CASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd='IN' THEN '(자체)' ELSE p.customer_name END AS "customerName",p.person_count AS "personCount", CASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd='IN' THEN NULL ELSE p.part_name END AS "partName" FROM source p WHERE ORDER BY p.proj_idp.proj_nm CASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd='IN' THEN '(자체)' ELSE p.customer_name END p.type_nameCASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd='IN' THEN NULL ELSE p.ctrt_amt END p.person_countCASE WHEN p.ctrt_type_cd='IN' THEN NULL ELSE p.part_name END p.status_namep.ctrt_bgn_dt ASCDESC NULLS LAST,p.proj_id ASC LIMIT #{filter.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM source p WHERE
SELECT count(*) FROM source p WHERE AND p.ctrt_type_cd<>'IN' AND p.part_id IS NULL

SELECT proj_id AS id,proj_nm AS name,cust_clnt_id AS "customerId",ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",proj_stat_cd AS status, ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate",work_plc_addr AS workplace,feature_cn AS feature, trim_scale(est_amt)::text AS "estimateAmount",trim_scale(orgnl_ctrt_amt)::text AS "originalContractAmount", trim_scale(ctrt_amt)::text AS "contractAmount",trim_scale(bdgt_amt)::text AS "budgetAmount", trim_scale(team_exps_amt)::text AS "teamExpenseAmount",trim_scale(proj_exps_amt)::text AS "projectExpenseAmount", bdgt_manual_yn AS "budgetManual",lose_dt AS "lossDate",lose_rsn_cd AS "lossReason",lose_memo AS "lossMemo",opp_id AS "opportunityId" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id}

SELECT (SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) AS "cashBase", (SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='TGT_MRGN_RT' AND aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) AS "marginRate", (SELECT c.code_val FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND c.code='TEAM_FEE' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y') AS "teamExpense", (SELECT c.code_val FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND c.code='PEXP_FEE' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y') AS "projectExpense"
SELECT clnt_id AS id,clnt_nm AS name,(use_yn='Y' AND clnt_type_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH')) AS active FROM tb_bs_clnt WHERE clnt_id=#{id}
SELECT part_id AS id,part_nm AS name,(use_yn='Y') AS active FROM tb_bs_part WHERE part_id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='CTRT_TYPE' AND c.code=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND cncl_yn='N')

SELECT substring(r.aply_bgn_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(r.aply_bgn_ym,5,2) AS "effectiveMonth",r.part_id AS "partId", b.part_nm AS "partName",r.chg_rsn AS reason,COALESCE(u.user_nm,r.reg_user_id) AS actor,(r.aply_bgn_ym>#{month}) AS scheduled FROM tb_pj_proj_part r LEFT JOIN tb_bs_part b ON b.part_id=r.part_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=COALESCE(r.mod_user_id,r.reg_user_id) WHERE r.proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_ym

SELECT s.user_id AS "userId",u.user_nm AS name,s.scope_sn AS "scopeSn" FROM tb_sy_user_scope s JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.proj_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' ORDER BY s.user_id,s.scope_sn

SELECT a.asgn_id AS "assignmentId",a.dev_id AS "developerId",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",d.dev_nm AS name, a.job_cd AS "jobCode",COALESCE(c.code_nm,a.job_cd) AS "jobName",a.input_bgn_dt AS "startDate",a.input_end_dt AS "endDate", a.ctrt_mm::text AS "contractMm",COALESCE((SELECT sum(m.mon_mm) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.proj_id=a.proj_id AND m.dev_id=a.dev_id),0.00)::text AS "monthlyMmTotal",a.asgn_stat_cd AS status FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code c ON c.code_grp_id='JOB' AND c.code=a.job_cd WHERE a.proj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd IN ('ACT','CNCL')('ACT') ORDER BY a.input_bgn_dt,a.asgn_id

SELECT h.hist_sn AS "historySn",h.chg_dt AS date,h.chg_item_cd AS "itemCode",h.chg_item_nm AS "itemName",h.bfr_val AS before,h.aft_val AS after, COALESCE(u.user_nm,h.reg_user_id) AS actor,to_char(h.reg_dttm,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AS "registeredAt" FROM tb_pj_proj_chg h LEFT JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=h.reg_user_id WHERE h.proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.reg_dttm DESC,h.hist_sn DESC
SELECT COALESCE(sum(m.mon_mm),0.00)::text FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_asgn_mon m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.proj_id=a.proj_id AND m.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT'

SELECT close_ym FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE' AND close_ym>=#{from} AND close_ym<=#{to} UNION SELECT input_ym FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND fix_yn='Y' AND input_ym>=#{from} AND input_ym<=#{to}
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE

UPDATE tb_pj_proj SET proj_nm=#{project.name},cust_clnt_id=#{project.customerId},proj_stat_cd=#{project.status},ctrt_bgn_dt=#{project.startDate},ctrt_end_dt=#{project.endDate}, work_plc_addr=#{project.workplace},feature_cn=#{project.feature},est_amt=CAST(#{project.estimateAmount} AS numeric),orgnl_ctrt_amt=CAST(#{project.originalContractAmount} AS numeric), ctrt_amt=CAST(#{project.contractAmount} AS numeric),bdgt_amt=CAST(#{project.budgetAmount} AS numeric),bdgt_manual_yn=#{project.budgetManual}, team_exps_amt=CAST(#{project.teamExpenseAmount} AS numeric),proj_exps_amt=CAST(#{project.projectExpenseAmount} AS numeric),mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE proj_id=#{project.id}
UPDATE tb_pj_proj_part SET aply_bgn_ym=#{newMonth},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{oldMonth}
